TABLE.NAME: local_aiquizgen_jobs
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per quiz/test generation request. Each question type is one step, generated through the shared local_aifeedback queue (load balancer).

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of generation form data (source descriptor, per-type counts, output mode, etc.)

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Extracted text from source(s) — cached for retry and visibility

FIELD.NAME: step
FIELD.COMMENT: Current step: mcq | shortanswer | essay | answersselect | coderunner | build

FIELD.NAME: stepattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Failed attempts of the current step

FIELD.NAME: generated
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the validated questions of each finished step

FIELD.NAME: resultquizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Created (or augmented) course-module ID of the quiz

FIELD.NAME: log
FIELD.COMMENT: Progress log lines (one entry per LLM call / step)
